answer: A newcomer enters only when an established agent vouches with a bond of 67 POA, forfeited in full if the newcomer is convicted of farming within 16 epochs. No honest sponsor risks 67 POA on a stranger, so a farm must buy 486 sponsors, each risking real money. What carries the gale here is verification, the summit of cost is what stops the farm, and the delta of the record keeps every claim checkable.
